discover.title: Introductory flights
discover.defaultDescription: A trial flight is the best way to discover gliding: you fly in a two-seater with one of the club’s experienced pilots.
discover.bookingText: Booking and payment are done online. Gift vouchers are available for individuals and companies.
discover.leavingSite: You will leave planeur35.org for the club’s payment page.
discover.step1Text: After the paperwork (the day licence is included in the voucher), your pilot shows you the glider, the safety instructions and how the flight will go.
discover.step2Text: The glider takes off towed by the club’s microlight, then releases at height. From there, no engine: just the wind and the silence.
discover.step3Text: You sit in the front, your pilot behind. How long you fly depends on the day’s weather.
discover.step4Text: Back on the ground, a few words about the flight, and all your questions about what comes next.
discover.practicalClothesText: Comfortable clothes, closed shoes, a cap and sunglasses.
discover.voucherPersonText: A named voucher to give for a birthday or a celebration.
discover.voucherCompanyText: Client gifts, staff committees, team days: several vouchers or a day at the airfield, on quotation.
discover.nextText: See how training works at the club, from the first flight to the badges, and the packages to fly all season.

data.title: Personal data
data.form: The contact form collects your name, email address, subject and message. This information is used only to answer your request and is not used for commercial purposes.
data.recipient: The message is sent by the email service Resend to the association’s mailbox.
data.technical: Like any website, the host records technical connection data (IP address, date and page viewed) to keep the site secure and working properly.
data.retention: Messages are kept for as long as needed to handle your request.
data.rights: You can ask for access to, correction or deletion of your data by writing to the email address given above. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the CNIL, the French data protection authority:

cookies.title: Cookies and third-party services
cookies.text: The website uses no advertising cookies and no audience measurement tools. A technical cookie may remember the language you chose; it is not used for tracking.
cookies.map: The airfield map loads its map tiles from OpenStreetMap: your IP address is then sent to that service.
